method: Python text reading only, anchored top-level literal registrations; cross-checked saved AST inventory by independent subagent

tests.name: extension installation supplies all research sectors and persistent profiles without changing the ten phase order
company founding and expansion require local merchant authority and move real money into recorded ownership
a civic facility in a commercial building shape cannot create a private company or sell nonexistent food stock
a company records each actual shop sale once, and a saved city keeps the revenue cursor
listing, share trading and acquisition conserve ownership and settle actual buyer and seller balances
research requires nearby scientific training and rejects unfunded or unknown projects atomically
each of the seven technologies spends resources and completes after elapsed research time
completed technologies change their connected city systems and expose ecological costs
pausing freezes extension jobs and manually changing the hour does not complete paid research
ingredients come from real local shop stock and cooking consumes a recipe before a saved timer produces its meal
fish soup and festival meals use their own ingredients and stated preparation times
cooking heat changes the quality of a meal while using the same actual ingredients
medical treatment pays an actual clinic fee and preserves its cooldown through save/load
death ends an actor’s activities and treatment cannot revive them; aging follows elapsed simulated time
organizations retain membership, accept real donations, and run paid festivals with saved cooldowns
pending research, cooking, companies and social actions resume deterministically with fractional frames
legacy core saves initialize extension state and remain playable
a failed load hook rolls back extension actor caches and the complete running timeline
bereavement follows current partners and divorce removes stale life profile family associations
extension validation rejects invalid resources, ownership, actor references and timers atomically
saved extension accounting cursors, cooldown identities and funded research jobs are validated before replacement
corruption moves actual public funds into an eligible poor actor, and evidence leads to delayed recovery rather than a reward
public resource diversions require the real civic job in either language and exclude private employers and ordinary workers
charitable donations are spent from organization funds to actual poor residents
NPCs use clinics autonomously and actual paid or authorized public treatment settles saved accounts
research and audits operate inside tall and underground facilities rather than requiring the ground floor doorway
appointments require qualified nearby residents and spend treasury funds while preserving the real assigned job
a trained student becomes a scientist and pays for research whose saved completion advances that resident’s skill
autonomous research respects personal reserves and urgent needs while accepting a trained Chinese research profession
the generated city autonomously funds and completes research through actual trained residents and laboratories
a skilled worker uses accumulated personal savings to found a company with real capital and registration fees
an ordinary traveler can report real ledger evidence before an audit case exists, with remote and repeated reports rejected atomically
market share includes sales at actual competing city shops outside registered companies
a deterministic mountain flood damages the district and residents and spends actual emergency funds
the extension remains finite, bounded, recoverable and deterministic over multiple accelerated game weeks
